description: A validated German behavioural-marker rating system used by instructors to assess anaesthesiology students’ planning and problem-solving, teamwork and leadership, and team-orientation skills during simulation training.
title: AS-NTS behavioural marker system

description: The ASAP 2.0 dataset is a public benchmark of approximately 24,000 student argumentative essays with human-assigned scores from 1 to 6, developed for automated essay-scoring research.
title: ASAP 2.0 dataset

description: The ASAP-SAS corpus is a publicly available Kaggle dataset of rubric-scored short-answer responses, prompts, rubrics, and human-rater agreement benchmarks used to evaluate automated scoring systems.
title: ASAP-SAS corpus of short-answer scoring prompts and rubrics

description: ASE-26 is Mikael Gorsky's twenty-one-module undergraduate curriculum for teaching agentic software engineering to engineering students with foundational computer science and software-engineering knowledge.
title: ASE-26

description: A set of adaptable environmental-education curriculum prototypes for primary and secondary schools and teacher education, developed by UNESCO-UNEP's International Environmental Education Programme with Malaysia's Curriculum Development Centre and the University of the Philippines' ISMED.
title: ASEAN subregional EE curriculum prototypes for primary and secondary schools and pre-/in-service teacher training

description: Asegúrate is a teacher-implemented secondary-school intervention developed by Del Rey and colleagues to reduce cyber-aggression, bullying, sexting, and abusive Internet and social-network use.
title: Asegúrate program

description: Ask-Elle is a web-based intelligent tutoring system developed for teaching first-year computer science students Haskell through strategy-based model tracing, property-based testing, and automated hints.
title: Ask-Elle

description: A Python and ChatGPT API chatbot developed by Saniya Vahedian Movahed et al.
title: Ask Me Anything (AMA)

description: ASPIRE is an authoring system and deployment environment developed for creating constraint-based intelligent tutors with domain models, student modelling, adaptive feedback, and problem selection.
title: ASPIRE

description: A Pennsylvania state-supported programme that creates multiple pathways into teaching through preparation partnerships and financial supports for high school students, adults, paraprofessionals, and college students.
title: Aspiring to Educate

description: ASReview is an open-source machine-learning platform developed for efficient abstract screening in systematic reviews by iteratively prioritizing records for reviewer classification.
title: ASReview

description: A clinical-scenario-based assessment developed by Ilic et al.
title: Assessing Competency in Evidence-Based Medicine (ACE) tool

description: Assessmake21 is a web-based digital self-assessment tool developed by Ourania Miliou and colleagues to help K–12 learners identify, reflect on, and document 21st-century skills during makerspace activities.
title: Assessmake21

description: A nursing-education guide developed by McCusker and colleagues that scores assessment vulnerability to generative AI and directs faculty toward targeted assessment improvements.
title: Assessment and AI Vulnerability Decision-Making Guide for Nursing

description: Assessment Integration Management (AIM) is a web-based system for creating tests, uploading test models and item pools, and running large-scale computerized-based-exam simulations with configurable testing and student parameters.
title: Assessment Integration Management (AIM)

description: A 10-item English-language Likert self-report scale developed by Ntumi Simon et al.
title: Assessment Integrity Scale

description: A scenario-based open-ended assessment developed by Jennifer M.
title: Assessment of Problem Solving Skills (APSS)

description: The ATSHWS is a 13-item analytic performance-based observation rubric developed by Şengör et al.
title: Assessment Tool for Surgical Hand Washing Skills (ATSHWS)

description: ASSET is a Web 2.0 video-feedback storage and sharing platform developed by the University of Reading for staff-created feedback resources with tiered learner access.
title: ASSET

description: ASSISTments is a free web-based platform developed and operated by the ASSISTments Project for assigning mathematics practice, providing feedback, and reporting student-performance data to teachers.
title: ASSISTments

description: A problem-level dataset from an ASSISTments randomized experiment comparing video and text hints during skill-builder assignments, made available for research on treatment-effect and assignment-completion prediction.

description: A set of publicly used learner–question interaction datasets from online tutoring and exercise platforms, used to develop and evaluate knowledge-tracing models.
title: ASSISTments2009, EdNet-KT1, and XES3G5M knowledge-tracing benchmark datasets

description: The ASSURE instructional model is a six-step lesson-planning framework developed by Heinich, Russell, Molenda, and Smaldino for analyzing learners, specifying objectives, selecting and using media, requiring participation, and evaluating instruction.
title: ASSURE instructional model

description: ASTRA is an end-to-end air-traffic-control training simulator developed by Ethan Chew and colleagues that automates the simpilot role through speech recognition, response generation, and geospatial scenario visualization.
title: ASTRA

description: Astus is a model-tracing tutor framework whose knowledge-based system represents procedural and declarative task knowledge so its pedagogical module can generate interventions and instructional content.
title: Astus

description: ASU CreateAI Chat is a secure, institutionally managed Arizona State University platform that provides a closed-system GPT-4o environment with retrieval-augmented generation for working with approved sources.
title: ASU CreateAI Chat platform

description: A corpus of 863 AI-generated educational questions in English, Mathematics, and Science, labeled by K–12 teachers with Bloom Taxonomy levels and related subject, grade-level, objective, and question metadata; it was created and released by Michael Lawrence Castanares et al.
title: Asyncform (AF) dataset

description: ASYST is a graphical interface developed by Ulrike Padó and colleagues that lets teachers locally generate and review automated short-answer grading suggestions from Excel files using German or English Transformer models.
title: ASYST (Automated Grading System)
